subject: reading
prompt: What is the main idea of this passage?
passage: Bees fly from flower to flower. They sip sweet nectar and carry pollen on their legs. This helps plants make seeds and fruit.
choices: Bees like to sleep in hives.
Bees help plants grow fruit and seeds.
answer: Bees help plants grow fruit and seeds.
hint: Ask what the whole passage is mostly about.

subject: reading
prompt: What is the main idea of this passage?
passage: Tomas practiced piano every day for a month. At first he missed many notes. Now he can play a whole song.
choices: Practice helped Tomas get better at piano.
answer: Practice helped Tomas get better at piano.
hint: What changed from the start to the end?

subject: reading
prompt: What is the main idea of this passage?
passage: Camels can go many days without water. They store fat in their humps. Their thick lashes keep sand out of their eyes.

answer: Camels have body parts that help them live in the desert.
hint: Each sentence tells about a camel body part.

subject: reading
prompt: Which sentence tells the main idea?

answer: A library has many fun things to do.
hint: Look for the idea that covers all the sentences.

subject: reading
